title: feat(nsopyft): nsopp y-probe formation-tick exist-opposite: reverse UNDEFINED, face HOLD
science: Formation-tick (strictly-earlier, q excluded) exist-opposite on nsopp y-probes: S(A) is empty because A is a seed and its origin partner is same-tick, so reverse is UNDEFINED while face holds from -e1/+e1 at C/D. States the band's timing asymmetry explicitly: 'holding reverse needs the later tick; holding face does not.'
